summary: Frontend E2E testing completed for Jerry PWA. All 40 assertions passed: login flow (success + wrong-password toast + jerry_token persistence), dashboard (Welcome Administrator, server-status-badge, dashboard-empty), bottom nav visible with all 5 items for admin, voice/shopping/settings pages render with expected testids, server URL normalization (example.com:5000 -> http://example.com:5000) persists via GET /api/settings, user CRUD (create guest with 1 page + 1 device, delete guest), RBAC (guest sees only nav-home; direct navigation to /voice, /users, /settings all redirect to /), and logout clears jerry_token and returns to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js registers <Protected page="users"> but ALL_PAGES in Users.jsx doesn't include a 'users' entry, so non-admins can never be granted the Users page even if desired (currently admin-only works via hasPage short-circuit, but this is an implicit contract - consider explicit admin-only guard).
React Router v6 future-flag warnings in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) - non-blocking but should opt-in for smoother v7 migration.
Console showed 500 errors from /api/proxy/* when node server unreachable - EXPECTED per request, UI correctly shows empty states.
test_credentials: admin/admin0466 (seeded); guest/1234 was created & deleted during test
seed_data_creation: Transient: created and deleted 'guest' user during test; server_url was updated to http://example.com:5000 (persists in backend settings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend flows green. Note: server_url in backend settings now points to http://example.com:5000 (updated during test). If subsequent tests depend on default 127.0.0.1:3000, main agent may want to reset. Node.js upstream is intentionally offline so /api/proxy/* returns 500/502 - this is expected.
